title: Çamlıca Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: Native outer ring of the named mosque relation.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain at the public uphill boundary outside the northwest courtyard gate.

mapIdentity.provider: Named present mosque relation, court opening and separately mapped dome, fountain canopy and minaret bases.
mapIdentity.scope: Current named multipolygon, courtyard opening, main dome, courtyard fountain canopy and six mapped minaret bases. Original elevation tiles supply the hill profile and terrace contact.

note: Diyanet and the Turkish Presidency report the completed 34 m diameter dome rising to 72 m and two groups of minarets, four of 107.1 m with three balconies and two of 90 m with two balconies. The exact 2024 Qualla photo gives a distant view of the standing cluster and its raised hilltop silhouette.
